verdict.rationale: Open WebUI has a documented Functions/Tools/Pipes/Filters plugin architecture (Python-based) with clear docs on writing and loading custom Functions/Tools locally, plus a separate documented Skills format (SKILL.md folders) for reusable instruction sets. This directly matches the story of writing and loading custom skills/tools/plugins against a documented format. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer confirmation of the plugin-writing workflow succeeding end-to-end, and no community corroboration specifically for the Functions/Tools authoring experience (only general sentiment exists).
